in_marathi.name: Shreyas
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shreyas हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Shreyas is derived from the Sanskrit word shri which means prosperity, wealth, and success. It is a name given to a boy with the hope that he will bring prosperity and success in his family and in his life.
